Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

# Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

 Wagner Logistics 

Oct 14, 2026, 08:54 ET

NORTH KANSAS CITY, Mo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wagner Logistics, a nationwide provider of third-party logistics, today announced it has signed a multi-year agreement with a Kansas City-area manufacturer to launch a new manufacturing support and warehouse operations program in Liberty, Mo.

The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. Wagner expects to add 79 new local jobs over the next two years, starting immediately. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation.

"This is exactly the kind of operation where Wagner's strengths come through," said Brian Smith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wagner Logistics. "It requires speed, flexibility, close coordination and the ability to design a solution around what the customer actually needs."

# Davinci Micro Fulfillment expands network, opens new eCommerce support facility in Pennsylvania

 AJOT Newsroom | Oct 07 2026 at 01:08 PM | Logistics 

Davinci Micro Fulfillment, which operates a distributed network of “micro site” fulfillment centers providing end to end order, inventory and shipping management for eCommerce sellers, has opened its sixth U.S. facility in Pennsylvania’s Jenkins Township.

Located in Luzerne County, at 141 Commonwealth Drive in CenterPoint Commerce & Trade Park South, the leased facility has 36,231 square feet of space and is purpose designed with equipment, resources and technology to support fulfillment of consumer brands marketed through eCommerce channels including Amazon, Walmart, TikTok and direct-to-consumer platforms.

Founded in 2020, Davinci forward-positions client inventory in smaller fulfillment centers close to consumers to accelerate delivery and reduce shipping costs. Flexport opens robot fulfillment center in old Kroger site

# Flexport opens robot fulfillment center at former Kroger site

Gowtham Ramachandran

Oct 13, 2026

Flexport has opened its first fully automated fulfillment center just outside Chicago. The company says more than 350 robots at the facility double the efficiency compared with a traditional warehouse. The center offers four times the storage and helps deliver 99.9% order accuracy. Flexport has not provided a baseline for these comparisons.

Flexport’s warehouse page lists a new automated facility in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin, with 250,000 storage bins and 386 robots running a goods-to-person system. The village approved Flexport’s plans for the 336,840-square-foot building in May, with 300 jobs across two shifts and operations expected to begin at the end of summer 2026, BizTimes reported. 

Kroger opened the site in 2022 as a robotic grocery fulfillment center built with Ocado. It announced last November that it would shut the center along with two other Ocado sites, expecting the closures to improve e-commerce operating profit by $400 million in 2026.

Workers and visitors gather inside an industrial facility as Hollingsworth Logistics Group expands near San Antonio.

A Michigan-based logistics company is expanding its operations near San Antonio, Texas, with plans to add 150 jobs and consolidate two existing facilities into a 340,090-square-foot warehouse along Interstate 35.

Hollingsworth Logistics Group has signed a seven-year lease at Park35, a growing industrial development in Schertz, northeast of San Antonio. The expansion will retain 224 existing positions, bringing the company's planned local workforce to 374 employees.
